speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. To better understand your gait and limb ataxia, could you tell me if you've noticed any weakness in your arms or legs, or any difficulty with coordination when reaching for objects?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like cerebellar ataxia. Have you experienced any changes in your speech, such as slurring or a "scanning" quality, or any trouble swallowing recently? Also, do you have a history of long-term alcohol use or recent head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST TEST: CSF PCR for JC virus.
